```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(dbplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(janitor)
library(showtext)

db_path <- file.path("C:/Users/kadon/OneDrive/Documents/MEDS/EDS-213/eds213-proj/database/database.db")
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = db_path)

dbListTables(conn)
```

```{r}
song_list <- tbl(conn, "song_list") %>%
  collect() %>%
  clean_names()
  
hip_hop_track_list <- tbl(conn, "hip_hop_track_list") %>%
  collect() %>%
  clean_names()

sample_list <- tbl(conn, "sample_list") %>%
  collect() %>%
  clean_names()

names(hip_hop_track_list)

names(sample_list)
```

```{r}
query_1 <- hip_hop_track_list %>%
  arrange(desc(duration_ms)) %>%
  mutate(duration_seconds = duration_ms / 1000) %>%
  select(track_name, artist_name, duration_seconds) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

query_1
```


```{r}
query_2 <- hip_hop_track_list %>%
  left_join(sample_list, by = c("song_tracking_id" = "song_id"),
            suffix = c("_track", "_sample")) %>%
  group_by(track_name_track, artist_name_track, duration_ms_track) %>%
  summarize(sample_duration_seconds = sum(duration_ms_sample, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(track_duration_seconds = duration_ms_track / 1000,
         total_duration_seconds = track_duration_seconds + sample_duration_seconds) %>%
  rename(track_name = track_name_track, artist_name = artist_name_track) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_duration_seconds)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

query_2
```

```{r}
names(hip_hop_track_list %>% 
        left_join(sample_list, by = c("song_tracking_id" = "song_id"),
                  suffix = c("_track", "_sample")))
```

```{r}
# Shared theme
theme_vinyl <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a1a", color = NA),
    panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a1a", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#333333"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    text               = element_text(color = "#f5e6c8", family = "lato"),
    plot.title         = element_text(family = "bebas", size = 18, color = "#e8a838"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 11, color = "#a89070"),
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "#f5e6c8", size = 9),
    axis.title         = element_text(color = "#a89070", size = 10),
    plot.margin        = margin(20, 30, 20, 20)
  )
}

accent_col <- "#e8a838"
stem_col   <- "#5c4a2a"

# --- Query 1 ---
p1 <- query_1 %>%
  mutate(track_name = fct_reorder(track_name, duration_seconds)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = duration_seconds, y = track_name)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = duration_seconds, yend = track_name),
               color = stem_col, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = accent_col, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title    = "TOP 10 LONGEST HIP HOP TRACKS",
    subtitle = "By track duration",
    x        = "Duration (seconds)",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_vinyl()

# --- Query 2 ---
p2 <- query_2 %>%
  mutate(track_name = fct_reorder(track_name, total_duration_seconds)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(track_duration_seconds, sample_duration_seconds),
               names_to = "type", values_to = "seconds") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type,
    "track_duration_seconds"  = "Track",
    "sample_duration_seconds" = "Samples"
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = seconds, y = track_name, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = query_2 %>% mutate(track_name = fct_reorder(track_name, total_duration_seconds)),
    aes(x = total_duration_seconds, y = track_name),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, color = accent_col, size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Track" = "#5c4a2a", "Samples" = "#e8a838")) +
  labs(
    title    = "TOP 10 LONGEST TRACKS + CUMULATIVE SAMPLE RUNTIME",
    subtitle = "Stacked by track duration and total sample duration",
    x        = "Duration (seconds)",
    y        = NULL,
    fill     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_vinyl() +
  theme(legend.position      = "top",
        legend.background    = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a1a", color = NA),
        legend.key           = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a1a", color = NA))
```

```{r}
p1
p2

ggsave("plot1.png", plot = p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = bg_col)
ggsave("plot2.png", plot = p2, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = bg_col)
```

```{r}
# --- Query 1 ---
p1 <- query_1 %>%
  mutate(track_name = fct_reorder(track_name, desc(duration_seconds))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = track_name, y = duration_seconds)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = track_name, xend = track_name, y = 0, yend = duration_seconds),
               color = stem_col, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = accent_col, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title    = "TOP 10 LONGEST HIP HOP TRACKS",
    subtitle = "By track duration",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Duration (seconds)"
  ) +
  theme_vinyl() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title  = element_text(size = 13))

# --- Query 2 ---
p2 <- query_2 %>%
  mutate(track_name = fct_reorder(track_name, desc(total_duration_seconds))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(track_duration_seconds, sample_duration_seconds),
               names_to = "type", values_to = "seconds") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type,
    "track_duration_seconds"  = "Track",
    "sample_duration_seconds" = "Samples"
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = track_name, y = seconds, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Track" = fill_track, "Samples" = fill_sample)) +
  labs(
    title    = "TOP 10 TRACKS + CUMULATIVE SAMPLE RUNTIME",
    subtitle = "Stacked by track duration and total sample duration",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Duration (seconds)",
    fill     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_vinyl() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position   = "top",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = bg_col, color = NA),
    legend.key        = element_rect(fill = bg_col, color = NA)
  )

p1
```
